_note: A2 systems engineer: the single inventory behind REQUIREMENTS.md, VERIFICATION-MATRIX.md and claims.json (run build_requirements.py). Rows with 'text' are new requirement nodes written to team/A2/claims.json; rows without 'text' reuse A1's nodes in params/claims.json (title and text are read from there, never copied). method: A analysis, I inspection, T test, D demonstration. evidence: repo-relative files the owner writes; the matrix marks which exist. 'limits' are A2's PROPOSED numbers that no params.json key holds yet: emitted as ASM-A2-* assumption nodes so claims can reference them today; CR-A2-01 asks A1 to adopt them as params.json#requirements.* keys.

requirements.how: Inspect the built aircraft against CONFIGURATION.md: 4 fixed motors on 2 fins, 2 elevon pairs, airspeed sensor, 4S, no field structural joint.
Energy budget: 2 min at hover power + 5 min at cruise power <= 0.8 x usable x pack energy (B1, E2); then one logged full mission landing with >= 20 % remaining (H2).

requirements.title: Props-off envelope
requirements.text: The props-off aircraft fits a 1.15 x 0.445 x 0.39 m box envelope (span x depth x height, params.json#transport.envelope_props_off_m) in one piece with no structural field joint; span may grow only if the measured car box (R-CAR-FIT) allows
requirements.how: Fusion assembly bounding box from check.py (A5); tape measure on the built aircraft, props off.
CLmax from XFOIL at Re 2-4e5 (B2) replaces ASM-A1-CLMAX; slow-flight stall in FBWA at altitude with airspeed logged (H2).
B1 shows cruise speed >= 1.3 Vs at the gate mass (CR-A1-05); airspeed logged at 'Transition FW done' (F4 message, H2 log).
Roll-up of every parts.csv against mass_budget.json (A3); weigh the assembled aircraft with pack, 1 g scale (H1, T-A1-WEIGH).

requirements.title: Subsystem mass allocations
requirements.text: Each subsystem's flying mass (sum of mass_g over its parts.csv) <= its allocation in params/mass_budget.json; every part has a mass and a status word; the growth reserve (350 g) is released only by A1 through a change request
requirements.how: A3 roll-up script per subsystem folder; weigh each subsystem's parts as built (H1 scale) and update parts.csv.

requirements.title: As-built CG range
requirements.text: As-built CG with the flight pack: x inside params.json#cg.x_range_m (0.045-0.075 m until B3 narrows it), z inside cg.z_range_m (-0.02 to +0.03 m), |y| <= 0.005 m; trim ballast counts inside the mass gate
requirements.how: A3 CG roll-up from part positions; balance the built aircraft on a knife edge at x = 0.060 m and on the centreline (H1 CG check).
AVL neutral point of the plank wing with fins, elevons neutral (B3, CR-A1-06); FBWA pitch response on the twin, then the full aircraft (H2).
Thrust stand, one station, 11x4.5MR at 14.8 V and 14.0 V: full-throttle thrust >= 1.30 kgf gives T/W 2.0 at 2.6 kg (H1, T-A1-THRUST-STATION).
Lean at 5 m/s from the flat-plate method <= ASM-A2-HOVER-LEAN-MAX (B1); twin then full aircraft hold position within 1 m in 5 m/s with logged lean (H2); fin-tip landing in 5 m/s without tip-over.

requirements.title: 8 m/s gust survive-and-land
requirements.text: The hover attitude needed to hold position in an 8 m/s gust (flat-plate method, wing broadside) is <= Q_A_ANGLE_MAX minus 5 deg (F4 sets Q_A_ANGLE_MAX accordingly), and the thrust needed at that lean (W / cos lean) leaves a thrust headroom >= 1.3 at the gate mass with voltage sag
requirements.how: B1 recomputes the lean with the gate mass and fin area; F4 writes Q_A_ANGLE_MAX >= lean + 5 deg into the parameter file; T/W with sag from R-HOVER-TW divided by 1/cos(lean).
Geometry from the as-built CG and footprint (C5); tilt the built aircraft on a board about the narrow axis until it tips (H1).

requirements.title: Directional stability in cruise
requirements.text: The plank wing with its two fins is directionally stable in cruise: Cn_beta >= +0.03 /rad at 1.3 Vs with elevons neutral and the CG at its aft limit (AVL, fins modelled as vertical surfaces at +/-0.32 m); the Dutch-roll mode is damped (no growing yaw oscillation in a hands-off FBWA run)
requirements.how: AVL stability derivatives at the aft CG (B3; J1's fin yaw-arm claim feeds it); hands-off FBWA run with yaw rate logged (H2).

requirements.title: Hover control authority
requirements.text: At the gate mass in hover, motor-differential control gives an angular acceleration on each body axis >= 2 rad/s2 and >= 1.5 x the acceleration the 5 m/s wind moment demands, using <= 30 % of hover thrust per motor as differential; yaw (about the hover vertical, from prop reaction torque) is the axis to show
requirements.how: Moment arms (0.32 m, 0.19 m) x thrust slope from the thrust table over the inertia from A3 (B3); twin holds position within 1 m in 5 m/s and the log shows no motor output saturation (H2).

requirements.title: Elevon authority in cruise
requirements.text: At 1.3 Vs with the CG at its aft limit, the elevons trim level flight using <= 50 % of the +/-25 deg travel, and the remaining travel gives a steady roll rate >= 90 deg/s (AVL with roll damping); pitch recovers a 10 deg upset without stalling
requirements.how: AVL trim and control derivatives at the aft CG (B3); FBWA flight with logged roll rate at full stick (H2).
Measure the cut panels (D1); B3 confirms the fraction gives R-CRUISE-AUTHORITY; frozen on the twin's result (H2).

requirements.title: Elevon servo torque
requirements.text: Each elevon servo's rated stall torque >= 1.5 x the summed hinge moment of its two panels at 25 deg deflection at the dive speed 1.3 x cruise (19.5 m/s), hinge moment from XFOIL (B2); the linkage holds that load without the horn or clevis slipping
requirements.how: B2 hinge-moment coefficient x q x S_e x c_e; D6 picks the servo; bench: hold the surface at 25 deg against a spring scale at the computed load (H1).
Fusion interference check (A5) then a ruler on the built aircraft: prop tip to tube face, to the other prop, to the wing tip.

requirements.title: Airspeed sensor placement and accuracy
requirements.text: The pitot sits outside the prop slipstream in cruise (>= 1 prop radius, 0.14 m, laterally clear of every disc edge, or ahead of the prop plane), and after ARSPD_AUTOCAL the airspeed reads within +/-1 m/s of GPS-derived true airspeed in a calm-air box pattern
requirements.how: B4 marks the wash boundary; F3 places the pitot; H2 flies a four-leg box in calm air and compares ARSPD with GPS ground speed.

requirements.title: Motor and ESC current
requirements.text: Full-throttle current per motor with the 11x4.5MR prop <= 36 A at 14.8 V (ESC 45 A continuous / 1.25) and <= 45 A at 16.8 V (fresh pack, momentary); total hover current within +/-15 % of 24 A as measured on the thrust stand and in the tethered hover
requirements.how: Thrust stand with a current logger at 14.8 V and 16.8 V, 0-100 % throttle (H1); BATT current in the tethered-hover log.

requirements.title: Flight pack mass and capacity
requirements.text: Each flight pack weighs <= 0.55 kg as received (else A3 re-budgets power before any CAD freezes) and delivers >= 92 % of nameplate capacity (>= 6.0 Ah) at 1C down to 3.5 V/cell on the charger's discharge test
requirements.how: Weigh each pack on arrival (1 g scale); one 1C discharge per pack on the charger, record Ah and the voltage curve.

E3 heat balance for motor, ESC in the fin wash, pack in the pod over the full mission; IR thermometer after the thrust-stand run and after a full-mission hover (H1/H2); ceiling written on the flight card.

requirements.title: Load cases defined
requirements.text: C1 publishes numbered load cases for every structure before sizing: flight limit load factor +3.0 / -1.5 at the gate mass with ultimate = 1.5 x limit; hover at maximum thrust (4 x 1.58 kgf) at the motor stations; transition (max thrust plus 1.3 Vs aero load); fin-tip landing at 1.5 m/s sink with 10 deg attitude error on one foot pair; tip-over onto a wingtip; transport (0.3 m box drop); handling (one-hand carry at the pod)
requirements.how: LOADS.md lists each case with the load, where it acts and the script that computed it; every structural claim cites a case id.

requirements.title: Structural margins
requirements.text: Every primary load path (spar, spar-slot bond, motor tube, tube-to-spar saddle, fin-tube joint, fin root bond, motor mount, pod-to-wing bond, pack retention, feet) has a margin of safety >= 0 at ultimate load (1.5 x limit) against stated material allowables, and the spar tip deflection at limit load <= 5 % of the semi-span
requirements.value: MS >= 0 at 1.5 x limit; deflection <= 0.05 x b/2
requirements.how: Beam and joint calculations per load case (C2-C6, each emitting claims); proof load of the spar and one motor station to limit load on the bench with deflection measured (H1).

requirements.title: Fin-tube-saddle joint
requirements.text: The fin, motor tube and saddle transfer the motor-station loads (1.58 kgf per motor at full thrust, plus the landing case) across the 0.18 m tube-to-spar offset with margin >= 0 at ultimate, using printed clips and epoxy on a real 22 mm tube; a printed clip is fit-checked on the tube before the December order
requirements.how: C4 load path and bond-area calculation; D3 prints the clip and saddle; photo of the clip on the tube in the fins SPEC before the order.

requirements.title: Motor-tube vibration
requirements.text: The first bending and torsion natural frequencies of each motor tube plus fin assembly with motors fitted lie outside +/-20 % of the 1P frequency at hover rpm and of 2P (blade pass), or a tap test shows the mode damped; the flight-controller vibration (ArduPilot VIBE) stays < 30 m/s2 in hover with Clip = 0
requirements.how: Cantilever beam model of the tube with tip masses (C4); tap test with the FC's IMU logging (H1); VIBE in the first hover log (H2).

requirements.title: Pack retained in a crash
requirements.text: The pack stays in the pod and the hatch stays closed under a 12 g deceleration in any axis (5 m/s arrested in 0.10 m of foam crush); the strap, tray and pod-to-wing bond carry that load with margin >= 0
requirements.how: C3 sizes strap and tray for 12 x pack weight (65 N); bench pull on the strapped pack with a spring scale to 65 N in each axis (H1).

requirements.title: Fin-tip landing
requirements.text: A vertical landing at 1.5 m/s sink (3 x the 0.5 m/s Q_LAND_SPEED default) with up to 10 deg attitude error is absorbed with no damage beyond the four replaceable feet; a foot is replaced in <= 10 min in the field with a knife and CA
requirements.how: Crush energy of the foot vs 0.5 x m x v2 (C5); drop the ballasted airframe from 0.115 m onto plywood, level and at 10 deg, inspect fins and tubes (H1); time a foot swap.
F1 rates every connector against the highest continuous current (24 A hover; 120 A momentary) and sizes wire; thermocouple on the main lead at 24 A for 2 min (H1).

requirements.title: Avionics power
requirements.text: The UBEC/BEC continuous rating >= 2 x the summed avionics current plus both servos at stall; the flight-controller rail stays >= 4.8 V with both servos stalled on the bench; the current and voltage sensor reads within +/-5 % of a meter at 24 A
requirements.how: Current budget from the datasheets (F1); bench stall both servos while watching the rail voltage; compare BATT_CURRENT with a clamp meter on the thrust stand (H1).

requirements.title: Wiring is an installation
requirements.text: Every wire in the wire list has a route, supports <= 0.15 m apart, chafe protection at every edge, strain relief at every connector and a service loop across each elevon hinge; the ESC-to-motor leads run along the fin; no connector carries structural load; the pack plug is the only field disconnect
requirements.how: Walk the built harness against the wire list with a ruler; every row ticked (F2); A4 checks every wire edge is acknowledged.
Board name on firmware.ardupilot.org under Plane stable (dated screenshot in the SPEC) before the order; a bench log written to SD/flash and downloaded.

requirements.title: Tailsitter parameter file
requirements.text: The parameter file in subsystems/flight-software/ sets Q_ENABLE 1, Q_TAILSIT_ENABLE 1, Q_TAILSIT_MOTMX for all four motors, Q_FRAME_CLASS 1, Q_FRAME_TYPE 1, Q_OPTIONS bit 18 (arm only in VTOL); the output map matches stations UR/UL/LR/LL and their rotation directions; every parameter name is checked against the installed firmware version named in the file header
requirements.how: Parameter diff against the file (F4); motor test in the ground station, props off, each station spins in the right direction in order (H1).

requirements.title: Arming and emergency stop
requirements.text: Arming requires a hardware or RC arm switch and the full ARMING_CHECK set; an RC emergency-stop switch stops all four motors within 1 s from any mode; props are off for every bench test of the electrics
requirements.how: Bench with props off: arm refused with a failed check, then time the stop from switch to zero rpm in the log (H1).

requirements.title: Failsafes and geofence
requirements.text: RC loss -> QLAND or QRTL; GCS loss (if telemetry is used) -> as configured; battery low -> return, critical -> land; Q_TRANS_FAIL -> QRTL; geofence = the RFS sub-field polygon plus the 400 ft ceiling with a fence action; each action is demonstrated in SITL and on the bench (props off, transmitter switched off, voltage simulated) before the first flight
requirements.how: SITL run per failsafe with the log attached (F4); bench demonstration of RC loss and low battery with the resulting mode shown in the ground station (H1); fence polygon loaded and checked on the map.

requirements.title: RC link and telemetry
requirements.text: The ELRS ground range check at the lowest power setting passes at >= 100 m with no failsafe; link quality stays >= 90 % in the flight logs across the sub-field out to the 500 m VLOS limit at 400 ft; RSSI/LQ and telemetry are logged
requirements.how: Range-check walk at RFS with the aircraft on the ground (F5); RCIN/LQ fields in the first QLOITER log at the far edge of the sub-field (H2).

requirements.title: Compass and GPS
requirements.text: Compass interference from the motor currents <= 30 % (COMPASS_MOT calibration at hover current); the GPS/compass mast keeps >= 0.10 m from the main power leads; HDOP <= 1.2 before arming
requirements.how: compassmot on the thrust stand or tethered (H1); ruler from the mast to the nearest power lead; HDOP in the pre-arm log.
Box fit from the envelope and wall thickness (CL-A1-BOX-FIT); place the props-off aircraft on its cradles, close the lid, weigh the loaded box (D7).

requirements.title: Field set-up time
requirements.text: From the closed box to the arm check in <= 5 min by one person with no tools: fit four props, seat and strap the pack, close the pack plug, arm check; the sequence is the checklist in the box
requirements.how: Timed by a second person on three field days; E1's prop retention method must need no tool.

requirements.title: Box fits two cars
requirements.text: The loaded box fits in at least two team members' cars (back seat or hatch), measured with the box dimensions and recorded before P6/P9 are frozen
requirements.how: Tape measure of the opening and the cargo space of two cars against 1.25 x 0.55 x 0.45 m; table in the transport SPEC.

requirements.title: Build processes
requirements.text: Every part in every parts.csv is bought or made by one of: hot-wire XPS from printed templates, packing-tape skin, knife- or laser-cut foam board, FDM PETG or PLA, epoxy or CA bonds, standard fasteners, hand-cut CF tube; no composite lay-up, no machining beyond drilling; printed parts <= 0.20 m on any axis
requirements.how: G1 checks the process column of every parts.csv against the list; G3 confirms the printer bed; the Jacobs foam-board laser answer is recorded (knife is the fallback).
Sum of G4's work-package estimates (plan 70-85 h); hours logged per build session against the plan.

requirements.title: Milestones
requirements.text: Twin flown before the order; electronics and CF tubes ordered by about 2026-11-20, everything else by 2026-12-15; first XPS hover by build week 4; first transition by week 7; complete by 2027-04-30 with one crash-repair loop (>= 1.5 weeks calendar) and the 7-business-day RFS request lead inside the plan
requirements.value: order 2026-12-15; hover wk 4; transition wk 7; done 2027-04-30
requirements.how: Dated schedule with the critical path and one repair loop; each milestone ticked with the date it happened.

requirements.title: Crash repair
requirements.text: A crashed wing core is re-cut and skinned in <= 1 day from stock on hand (>= 1 spare XPS sheet, hot-wire templates and printed-part STLs kept in the repo); the BOM holds spares: 1 motor, 4 ESCs, 8 props, 1 CF tube, 4 feet
requirements.how: Spare lines present in the BOM (I1); the second core cut during the build is timed from sheet to skinned core (G2).
Priced BOM with tax 10.25 %, shipping and spares, re-priced on order day (I1).
Reserve = 2 000 - pessimistic spend from the BOM, on order day (CL-A1-RESERVE).

requirements.title: Every part connected
requirements.text: Every part in every interfaces.json has at least one structural interface and, where it carries current or heat, an electrical or thermal one; interfaces/merge_check.py and fusion/check.py pass with zero floating parts and zero unacknowledged edges
requirements.how: Run both checkers; the merged report lists zero floating parts (A4) and the Fusion stub build shows every component on a joint (A5).

requirements.title: Joint stacks
requirements.text: Every fastened or bonded joint in the README joint table has a joint-stack entry: fastener size x length and grade or adhesive, hole or insert, thread engagement >= 1.0 x diameter in a heat-set insert (or >= 2.0 x in bare plastic), torque or 'snug + threadlocker', tool, access direction, install and removal order
requirements.how: C6 table row per joint id; A4 checks every fastened edge in interfaces.json carries the stack fields.

requirements.title: Proof chain builds
requirements.text: proofs/build_graph.py exits 0 with zero drift; every requirement in this set has >= 1 claim with a how-to-verify line before CDR; build_graph.py --strict passes (no negative margin, no unverified requirement) before the first flight
requirements.how: Run build_graph.py and build_requirements.py; the matrix header shows coverage and fails.

requirements.title: FAA and university compliance
requirements.text: Take-off mass < 25 kg (covered by R-MASS-GATE); FAA registration done and the number displayed on the airframe; each pilot holds a TRUST certificate and AMA membership; aircraft and pilots registered with the UC Drone Program under a PI sponsor; the FAA UAS facility map for RFS checked once and the airspace class recorded
requirements.how: Documents on file and listed in COMPLIANCE.md with dates; photo of the registration label on the airframe.

requirements.title: Site rules and flight card
requirements.text: Flights only at RFS yellow sub-fields 1-4, within 06:00-sunset (flight card 07:00-10:00), <= 400 ft AGL, VLOS <= 500 m from the pilot, with a spotter, a request >= 7 business days ahead and a post-flight report within 3 business days; no Remote ID module while every flight is inside the FRIA (a conditional line stays in the BOM)
requirements.how: Flight card signed per session; request and report dates logged; geofence (R-FAILSAFES) matches the sub-field.

requirements.title: Battery handling
requirements.text: Packs are stored and carried at storage charge (3.80-3.85 V/cell) in a LiPo bag; charged attended on a non-flammable surface with sand or an extinguisher at hand, never in a car; inspected for puffing before every charge; bought from US stock and shipped by ground
requirements.how: Procedure sheet in the charging box; per-session checklist signed; cell voltages logged at storage.

requirements.title: Pilot readiness
requirements.text: The designated pilot logs >= 10 h of ArduPilot SITL on the tailsitter model with the team's parameter file, including QSTABILIZE recovery from a failed transition, plus stick time on the foam-board twin or a small quad, before the first XPS hover
requirements.how: Dated SITL log with hours and the scenarios flown (H2); SITL runs stay UNVERIFIED until the team runs them (SITL is not on the design machine).

requirements.title: Foam-board twin gate
requirements.text: The foam-board twin on the real motors, FC and pack holds position within 1 m in calm air and in a 5 m/s fan or breeze with logged lean <= 20 deg; flies QLOITER at >= 30 m; completes a transition at >= 15 m/s, two laps and a back-transition; hover current within +/-15 % of 24 A and cruise near 13 A; the elevon size that gives clean FBWA authority is recorded. A wind fail triggers the K11 planform test, then the K01 fallback (CONFIGURATION.md)
requirements.how: Each flight logged; the report lists the pass criteria with the measured value beside each.

requirements.title: Test gates in order
requirements.text: Gates passed and logged in order, none skipped: (1) twin (R-TWIN); (2) thrust stand, one station (R-HOVER-TW); (3) XPS aircraft weigh-in (R-MASS-GATE) and tethered hover with current within +/-15 % of 24 A; (4) untethered QHOVER/QLOITER; (5) fixed-wing tune as a plain flying wing; (6) first transition at >= 50 m AGL with QSTABILIZE recovery rehearsed; (7) back-transition at altitude; (8) landing practice in calm air; (9) full mission (R-MISSION). H3 gives go/no-go on the 5 m/s flight card
requirements.how: Test plan with one page per gate; each gate's log file named in the plan when passed.

requirements.title: RFS wind measured
requirements.text: RFS morning wind is measured with a handheld anemometer on >= 3 mornings at 2 m height against the RCMC1 real-time reading; the ratio RFS/RCMC1 is < 1.4 (else the K01 reversal in CONFIGURATION.md applies) and the flight-card limit is rescaled to the measured ratio
requirements.how: Table of date, time, RFS reading, RCMC1 reading, ratio; mean ratio reported.

limits.title: Limit load factor +3.0 / -1.5
limits.text: Flight limit load factor +3.0 (negative -1.5) at the gate mass; ultimate = 1.5 x limit
limits.basis: Conventional small-UAV value; the wing cannot exceed n = (1.3 x 15 / 11.6)^2 = 2.8 at the dive speed before stalling, so 3.0 bounds any pull-up. C1 re-derives

limits.title: Ultimate safety factor 1.5
limits.text: Ultimate load = 1.5 x limit load for every structure; foam and bond allowables carry their own knock-downs
limits.basis: FAR 23.303 practice; the previous design used 1.5 (docs/DESIGN-BASIS.md)

limits.title: Landing sink rate 1.5 m/s
limits.text: Design vertical landing sink rate 1.5 m/s, equivalent to a 0.115 m drop
limits.basis: 3 x the ArduPilot Q_LAND_SPEED default of 0.5 m/s, covering a late flare or a gust in the last metre; C5 re-derives

limits.title: Landing attitude error 10 deg
limits.text: Landing touches down with up to 10 deg of attitude error, so one foot pair takes the first contact
limits.basis: Within the 37 deg narrow-axis tip-over angle with margin; typical attitude noise of a tailsitter landing in 5 m/s

limits.title: Transport drop 0.3 m
limits.text: The loaded box survives a 0.3 m drop onto a flat surface with the aircraft on its cradles
limits.basis: A box slipping from a car boot sill; C1 and D7 re-derive

limits.title: Crash deceleration 12 g
limits.text: The pack and avionics are retained at 12 g in any axis
limits.basis: A 5 m/s impact arrested in 0.10 m of foam crush: a = v^2 / (2 s) = 125 m/s2 = 12.7 g; C1 re-derives

limits.title: Spar tip deflection 5 % of semi-span
limits.text: Wing tip deflection at limit load <= 5 % of the semi-span (29 mm)
limits.basis: Keeps the tape skin and the elevon linkage within their working range; C2 re-derives

limits.title: Frequency separation 20 %
limits.text: Natural frequencies of the motor-tube assembly stay outside +/-20 % of the 1P and 2P forcing at hover rpm
limits.basis: Common rotorcraft placement rule; a tap test can override it with a measured damping

limits.title: FC vibration 30 m/s2
limits.text: ArduPilot VIBE in hover < 30 m/s2 on every axis
limits.basis: ArduPilot vibration guidance: below 30 is good, above 60 causes EKF trouble

limits.title: Lateral CG offset 5 mm
limits.text: |y| of the as-built CG <= 0.005 m
limits.basis: Noted in params.json#cg.y_target_m; keeps hover roll trim inside the motor-differential authority

limits.title: Cn_beta 0.03 /rad
limits.text: Directional static stability derivative Cn_beta >= 0.03 /rad in cruise, elevons neutral
limits.basis: Lower end of the 0.03-0.10 /rad band of small conventional aircraft; the fins are the only vertical surfaces; B3 re-derives with AVL

limits.title: Hover control acceleration 2 rad/s2
limits.text: Available angular acceleration from motor differential >= 2 rad/s2 on every hover axis at hover throttle
limits.basis: Order of magnitude a quad needs to hold attitude in gusts; weakest on the reaction-torque axis; B3 re-derives

limits.title: Control over disturbance 1.5
limits.text: Control moment available >= 1.5 x the aerodynamic disturbance moment at 5 m/s on each axis
limits.basis: Leaves half the authority for manoeuvre; B3 re-derives

limits.title: Trim uses half the travel
limits.text: Elevon deflection to trim level flight at 1.3 Vs with the aft CG <= 50 % of the mechanical travel
limits.basis: Leaves the other half for control; standard sizing rule for reflexed plank wings

limits.title: Roll rate 90 deg/s
limits.text: Steady roll rate at 1.3 Vs with full elevon >= 90 deg/s
limits.basis: Enough to level from a 45 deg upset in 0.5 s; B3 re-derives with AVL

limits.title: Servo torque factor 1.5
limits.text: Servo stall torque >= 1.5 x the hinge moment at full deflection and dive speed
limits.basis: Hobby practice; covers linkage friction and stall-torque spread between units

limits.title: Pitot one prop radius from the wash
limits.text: Pitot tip >= 1 prop radius laterally clear of every disc edge, or ahead of the prop plane
limits.basis: Slipstream contraction and swirl stay within about one radius of the disc edge; B4 re-derives

limits.title: Airspeed error 1 m/s
limits.text: Calibrated airspeed error <= 1.0 m/s
limits.basis: The transition margin 1.3 Vs - Vs = 3.5 m/s; a 1 m/s error keeps >= 2.5 m/s of it

limits.title: Hover current tolerance 15 %
limits.text: Measured hover current within +/-15 % of the predicted 24 A
limits.basis: P23 pass criterion

limits.title: Hover lean at 5 m/s 20 deg
limits.text: Logged hover lean in a 5 m/s wind <= 20 deg
limits.basis: Tie-break twin pass criterion: 16 deg predicted, <= about 20 deg accepted

limits.title: Attitude limit margin 5 deg
limits.text: Q_A_ANGLE_MAX >= the 8 m/s lean + 5 deg
limits.basis: Keeps the controller off its attitude limit in the gust case

limits.title: Thrust headroom at gust lean 1.3
limits.text: Max thrust with sag / (W / cos lean) >= 1.3 at the 8 m/s lean
limits.basis: Leaves 30 % for attitude control while leaning; at 36 deg and T/W 2.26 the value is 1.83

limits.title: Emergency stop 1 s
limits.text: All motors stopped within 1 s of the emergency-stop switch
limits.basis: Config-study D8

limits.title: SITL hours 10
limits.text: Pilot logs >= 10 h SITL before the first XPS hover
limits.basis: Config-study D15; P22

limits.title: First transition at 50 m
limits.text: First transitions at >= 50 m AGL, below the 122 m (400 ft) ceiling
limits.basis: Tie-break decision section 5.2: room to recover a post-handoff dive

limits.title: VLOS distance 500 m
limits.text: The aircraft stays within 500 m of the pilot
limits.basis: Config-study mission M-A: one RFS sub-field

limits.title: Link quality 90 %
limits.text: ELRS link quality >= 90 % throughout the flight envelope
limits.basis: Well above the ELRS failsafe region; F5 re-derives from the receiver's thresholds

limits.title: Range check 100 m
limits.text: Ground range check at the transmitter's lowest power passes at >= 100 m
limits.basis: At 10 mW a 100 m pass implies kilometres at full power; F5 re-derives

limits.title: Compass interference 30 %
limits.text: COMPASS_MOT interference at hover current <= 30 %
limits.basis: ArduPilot compassmot guidance: < 30 % acceptable, > 60 % move the compass

limits.title: Mast to power lead 0.10 m
limits.text: GPS/compass >= 0.10 m from the main power leads and ESCs
limits.basis: Field falls with distance from a 24 A conductor; F3 re-derives

limits.title: HDOP 1.2
limits.text: GPS HDOP <= 1.2 before arming
limits.basis: ArduPilot GPS_HDOP_GOOD default 140 (1.4); 1.2 leaves margin for QLOITER

limits.title: UBEC rating factor 2
limits.text: UBEC continuous rating >= 2 x (avionics + servo stall) current
limits.basis: Servo stall peaks and the previous design's BEC finding (inputs/DECISIONS-ADOPTED.md)

limits.title: Wire support spacing 0.15 m
limits.text: Every wire supported at least every 0.15 m
limits.basis: Advisor lesson 3 (wiring as installation); F2 re-derives

limits.title: Printed part 0.20 m
limits.text: No printed part exceeds 0.20 m on any axis
limits.basis: Fits the Jacobs Prusa bed (250 x 210 mm) with margin; G3 confirms

limits.title: Thread engagement 1 d in inserts
limits.text: Useful thread engagement >= 1.0 x diameter in a heat-set insert, >= 2.0 x in bare plastic
limits.basis: Advisor lesson 2; C6 re-derives per insert type

limits.title: Foot replacement 10 min
limits.text: A crushed foot is replaced in the field in <= 10 min
limits.basis: Fits inside one flight-day turnaround; D5 designs for it

limits.title: Core re-cut 1 day
limits.text: A replacement wing core is cut and skinned within 1 day

limits.title: Pack capacity 92 % of nameplate
limits.text: Delivered capacity at 1C to 3.5 V/cell >= 92 % of nameplate (6.0 of 6.5 Ah)
limits.basis: Typical new-pack delivery; the endurance budget already keeps 20 % reserve; E2 re-derives

limits.title: RFS/RCMC1 wind ratio 1.4
limits.text: Measured RFS wind / RCMC1 wind < 1.4
limits.basis: CONFIGURATION.md reversal condition
